steps.name: check-deps
steps.description: Verify t0008_tts_eval_harness_baselines is completed and its harness/prompt-set/split outputs are available.

steps.name: init-folders
steps.description: Create task folder structure and initial files.

steps.name: research-papers
steps.description: Review any corpus papers on F5-TTS, CosyVoice 2, Chatterbox, and GE2E speaker-similarity evaluation methodology.

steps.name: research-internet
steps.description: Look up install/inference requirements, checkpoints, and streaming-output support for F5-TTS, CosyVoice 2, and Chatterbox.

steps.name: research-code
steps.description: Review the t0008 harness code, t0014 reference-concat approach, and t0015 audio quality gate for reuse.

steps.name: planning
steps.description: Design the 3-system x 2-condition zero-shot cloning benchmark plan, cost estimate (hard cap $70), and asset list.

steps.name: setup-machines
steps.description: Provision LLM-T1-NC80 (H100), install model dependencies, arm the idle watchdog before the first model download.

steps.name: implementation
steps.description: Run smoke gate, warmup, and measured synthesis for F5-TTS, CosyVoice 2, and Chatterbox (ref_single/ref_concat) plus the ElevenLabs and v3 baselines through the t0008 harness; collect per-clip metrics and audio samples.

steps.name: teardown
steps.description: Deallocate LLM-T1-NC80 and confirm no idle billing after synthesis completes.

steps.name: creative-thinking
steps.description: Consider alternative explanations for the speaker_sim gap and whether the success criterion should be restated.

steps.name: results
steps.description: Write results_summary.md, results_detailed.md, metrics.json, charts, and the listening guide.

steps.name: compare-literature
steps.description: Compare reachable speaker_sim/TTFB envelope against published F5-TTS/CosyVoice2/Chatterbox benchmark numbers.

steps.name: suggestions
steps.description: Write suggestions.json, including a proposed restated success criterion and a possible production-integration follow-up task.

steps.name: reporting
steps.description: Final verification pass, session capture, and PR creation.
